name: a-row-title-uses-the-whole-row
description:
The close button used to hold 17px of every row whether or not anything was hovering, so a title that would have fitted was cut with an ellipsis. It is laid over the title's tail now instead of sitting in the flow.

Measures the title box with the pointer away from the row and again with the pointer on it: the box must not change, or the text reflows under the hand. The title uses a padding rather than a mask fade, so the hovered title's text ends before the button rather than fading out under it.

actions.expression: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)'); const row = pane.querySelector('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow'); const t = row.querySelector('.tl'); const rb = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const tb = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(tb.width) + ' of ' + Math.round(rb.width); })()

(() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)'); const row = pane.querySelector('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow'); const t = row.querySelector('.tl'); const rb = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const tb = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return String(Math.round(rb.right - tb.right)); })()

(() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)'); const row = pane.querySelector('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow'); const t = row.querySelector('.tl'); const rb = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const tb = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(tb.width) + ' of ' + Math.round(rb.width); })()

(() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)'); const row = pane.querySelector('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow'); const t = row.querySelector('.tl'); const x = row.querySelector('.x'); if (!x) { return 'no button'; } const xb = x.getBoundingClientRect(); const tb = t.getBoundingClientRect(); const over = xb.left < tb.right && xb.right > tb.left; const shown = Number(getComputedStyle(x).opacity) > 0; return (over ? 'over' : 'beside') + ',' + (shown ? 'shown' : 'hidden'); })()

(() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)'); const row = pane.querySelector('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow'); const t = row.querySelector('.tl'); const x = row.querySelector('.x'); if (!x) { return 'no button'; } const pad = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(t).paddingRight); const textRight = t.getBoundingClientRect().right - pad; return x.getBoundingClientRect().left >= textRight ? 'clear' : 'under'; })()

assertions.desc: THE MEASUREMENT: only the row's own 8px padding sits past the title, not the button's 17px too
the button appears over the title's tail rather than beside it
and the title's text ends before the button, so no glyph lands on text
